dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Approximately 5 prominent elliptical 'O' and interlocking 'C' shaped structures with high-contrast light-intensity perimeters; geometry is irregular with sharp gradient transitions from the dark exterior fur to the light-intensity ring lines.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of low-intensity dark pixel clusters which serve as the internal cores for the light-colored annuli; core pixel concentration is uniform and lacks significant internal gradients, particularly in the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle; a secondary grouping of four smaller lateral rings forms an irregular quadrilateral relationship on the lower flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive abrupt transition zone between the near-solid dark saturation of the anterior neck/head region and the high-contrast reticulated pattern of the dorsal-lateral body.
